out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH THE FAIRFAX COUNTY’S VOMIT AND DIARRHEA CLEAN UP PROCEDURES. PLEASE RETAIN FOR FUTURE REFERENCE.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: Observed the chlorine-based sanitizing solution at a concentration less than 50ppm.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. PIC ORDERED A BOTTLE OF BLEACH DURING THE INSPECTION. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INSTRUCTIONS TO MAKE CHLORINE BASED SANITIZING SOLUTION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition. Upon discussion with PIC, EHS discovered no Employee Health policy in place.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS GAVE THE FAIRFAX COUNTY “EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT” TO PIC TO PHOTOCOPY AND HAVE FOOD PREP STAFF READ AND SIGN. PLEASE RETAIN DOCUMENTS.
